programs.title: One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Diary of A Teen Leopard
programs.desc: The story of Pemba the leopard, who cannot cope with hunting.His mother provides all his meals.One day, however, the leopard is injured, and the son must face his fears in order to survive.

programs.title: Animal fights
programs.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see how much the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and how much on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.

programs.title: American Amazon
programs.desc: The creators of the series invite viewers to discover the wild wetlands of the southern United States.You can observe unique flora and fauna there, whose richness rivals that of the Amazon.

programs.title: Moody Beasts
programs.desc: Viewers will find answers to questions about animals.They will learn why male moose become covered in their own urine, clownfish change sex, and the brown moose dies after mating.

programs.title: Wild Vietnam: Season 1
programs.sub_title: The mysterious north: the land of mountain forests
programs.desc:
Let's set off on a journey through the picturesque forests and majestic mountains of northern Vietnam to reach the lush, tropical Mekong River Delta.Once there, we will begin a fascinating search for the last endemic species of local fauna and flora.Even though they are discovered only several dozen years after the end of the war, many animals are still at risk of extinction.The wildlife of the country located on the Indochinese Peninsula dynamically regenerates in times of peace, restoring the former richness of its landscape.However, rapid population growth, intensive construction development, growing climate crisis and increased tourist traffic constitute new, serious challenges for this region.
We visit Vietnamese forests.In spring, you can observe a variety of butterfly species there.Animals at risk of extinction have been found in the mountainous regions of the country, such as pangolins, palm cilantroes and light-headed lutungas from Cat Ba Island.The crocodile lizard, whose presence was discovered relatively recently, immediately became an object of smuggling.Saving the white-faced lutungs turned out to be a difficult challenge.The animals were in great danger, but they managed to find refuge in a nature reserve.

programs.title: Animals Gone Wild
programs.desc: The program presents the most extraordinary moments from the lives of animals.Viewers will see both suspenseful and shocking footage.

programs.title: Weather Gone Viral: Season 9
programs.desc: Nat Geo Wild explores the beauty and ferocity of the animal kingdom, offering an intimate look at the world’s most incredible creatures in their habitats.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr Pol 4
programs.desc: In Dr. Pol's clinic, the following people are waiting for help: an overly excited guinea pig, piglets whose mother does not want to feed them, and a newborn calf with a twisted hip joint.Natalie Wernette, owner of Hearty Harvest Farmers Market, who is hosting a chili cooking competition for the first time this year, comes to the doctor.She encourages the doctor to become a judge.Pol agrees, but before he can participate in eating the treats, he will have to help the next patients: a hedgehog and an old stallion.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr Pol 4
programs.desc: Dr. Pol has been treating animals for many years.He uses his knowledge and skills to help pet owners in the Michigan region.He is supported by trained colleagues.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 9
programs.desc: Dr. Pol has been treating animals for many years.He saved the life of more than one animal.He is helped every day by his colleagues who are willing to make sacrifices.

programs.title: Incredible Dr. Pol 10
programs.desc: Another season of hard work by Dr. Jan Pol and his colleagues.The team will need a new member because Dr. Emily is expecting a baby and someone will have to replace her.
